parts.text: 分类 § 人名和地名的前面，一般不加冠词，大多数情况都是专有名词 海洋、河流、山脉和部分国名前，加定冠词the
a / an 表示泛指(可数名词单数)
the 表示特指(名词单复数)
零冠词 不加冠词(复数、专有名词，国家简写、人名、城市名等)
He has a house in London.
the Atlantic 大西洋（注意the的读音）
The Great Wall 万里长城
the Alps 阿尔卑斯山脉
the United States 普通名词 变过来的 专有名词，所有前面要加the。
当some与any都表示：“一些、许多”的时候，在句子类型中有以上的区别 §

headers: any 用于否定和疑问句
rows: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any (children) in sight..
Is there any milk in the bottle? There isn't any milk in the bottle, but there is some water in it.
Are there any nails in that tin? There aren't any in the tin, but there are some on the shelf.
